name: post-write-enforce
description: Reminds AGENTS.md Rule 6 (Scope & Post-Write). After a write or edit touches a path containing .agents/, or (1.5.0) a successful shell command writes there (redirect, tee, sed -i, cp/mv/rm, git mv/rm, python3 file writes; scripts/detect-shell-write.py), sets a flag. Fail-open: the next non-shell tool call is blocked ONCE with a reminder to run post-write.sh, then the flag is cleared; a successful shell command that RUNS post-write.sh also clears it (1.4.0: a command that only mentions post-write.sh no longer does; regression cases in tests/clear-flag-cases.sh). 1.6.0: a post-write.sh run clears only the files it was run on (was: the whole flag, so `post-write.sh A` dropped a pending B); a failed shell command (PostToolUseFailure) is checked too, flagging only targets with evidence of a change (modified in the last 10 min, or gone for a deletion) since that event also fires for denied calls; $PWD resolves to the cd-tracked directory; tests/flag-lifecycle-cases.sh. Not detected by design: files written inside a script that a shell command runs (bash some-script.sh) — the script's own contract must call post-write.sh. Exempt: log.md, CHANGELOG.md, index.md files.
